segments.t: Back in the corridor, Chef Barinov urges Mikhail to give up cards for good, right before Eleonora summons the chef to her office and Nastya takes a mysterious phone call.
Миша, может, тебе больше не играть?
Ну пойми, что это не твоё.
Нет, я ещё ничего не сказала.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Миша, может, тебе больше не играть?
'Misha, maybe you should not play anymore?' Chef Barinov raises the pitch on 'to play' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
Ну пойми, что это не твоё.
'Just understand that this is not for you.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'come on', while 'your' completes the thought.
'I know how to play very well.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'to play' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I was simply unlucky today.' Mikhail anchors the line on 'simply', while 'to be lucky' completes the thought.
'The hotel owner is calling me to her office.' In Russian, the idea of 'landlady' flows naturally into 'is inviting' without extra filler words.
'Someone has already reported everything to her.' Notice how Russian expresses 'to her' and 'reported' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Nastya answers right away.
'Hello, yes, I can talk now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'hello' and 'to speak' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'No, Kostya is not nearby right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'no' before landing on 'beside'.
Нет, я ещё ничего не сказала.
'No, I have not said anything yet.' The grammar packs 'no' and 'told' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Maybe I will tell him tonight.' Nastya anchors the line on 'maybe', while 'in the evening' completes the thought.
'No, it is better if I tell him myself.' The grammar packs 'no' and 'myself' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.

'Alright, that is all, I have to go.' The meaning hinges on 'everything' working together with 'it's time' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Миша, может, тебе больше не играть?
Ну пойми, что это не твоё.
Нет, я ещё ничего не сказала.
Overhearing Nastya whisper that she will tell him everything tonight convinces Kostya that his wife is hiding a secret affair. See you next time!
